settings.heading: The gift that makes you look like you thought of everything.
settings.intro:
Corporate gifting isn't really about the gift — it's about what it says about the person who chose it. This is for whoever's name is on the order: the one who needs the client, the new hire or the partner to open the box and think someone here has taste, because that reflects back on you.

Hand block-printed totes, pouches and hampers made in Jaipur, matched to your brand's colours, quote-based with MOQs from 50 pieces — nothing that reads as an afterthought, so the only phone call you get afterward is a good one.
settings.hero_alt: Hand block-printed desk organiser set with a PEXX-branded card holder, styled on a wooden desk.
settings.hero_caption: A desk that says something about the person who furnished it.
settings.trust_design_detail: Colours, prints, even a co-branded fabric label reading “PEXX × Your Company” — down to your minimum order. Smaller batch? Choose straight from our print library instead.

settings.heading: Diwali Corporate Gifting
settings.image_alt: Pink block-print floral fabric wine bottle bag, corporate Diwali gift, styled outdoors with a wine bottle.
settings.body: Wine, kombucha, a fancy bottle of something — whatever's inside is fine, but it says nothing about the person who sent it. Wrap it in hand block-print instead of cellophane, and the drink's forgotten by dinner — the cover isn't. It's what stays on a shelf, catching their eye all year, quietly reminding them who has good taste.

settings.heading: Employee Onboarding & Welcome Kits
settings.image_alt: Two hand block-printed laptop sleeves, teal geometric and pink floral prints, on a wooden desk with a laptop.
settings.body: The welcome kit that doesn't end up in a drawer. A laptop sleeve and a bottle cover, block-printed and azo-free, in prints for every kind of new hire — not one generic kit forced on everyone regardless of taste. It's the first proof a new employee gets that this is a company that actually thought about them — and that's the kind of welcome people stay motivated by.

settings.heading: Client Gifting
settings.image_alt: Blue gingham block-print desk organiser set — tray, pen cup, notebook, pouch and card holder — styled on a desk.
settings.body: Move over the same brown leather set every vendor sends — minimalism's had its decade, and this is a desk with character, in checks or florals, so no client gets the same generic default. Whatever else finishes and gets forgotten; a hand-picked, hand-crafted set is still on the desk a year later — and it's still your name they think of when they see it.

settings.heading: New-Parent Employee Gifts
settings.image_alt: Hand block-printed baby swaddle set and a rolled baby quilt, both azo-free cotton.
settings.body: HR gifting the same swaddle-and-quilt set we sell at retail — hand block-printed, azo-free cotton for the newest member of an employee's family. It's the kind of gift a new parent actually talks about at their desk for weeks — and the reason they remember exactly who thought of them at the one moment that mattered most.

settings.heading: Events & Conferences
settings.image_alt: Three block-print cotton tote bags — pomegranate print, navy stripe, and a leaf print with a 'Your Brand Logo' placeholder — hanging against a wall.
settings.body: The tote that doesn't end up abandoned under a chair by the end of the day. Hand block-printed in your event's colours, with your logo where the tag usually goes — carried out of the venue and used for months after, instead of forgotten with the rest of the giveaways. That's brand recall you don't have to pay for twice.

settings.heading: Everyday Employee Occasions
settings.image_alt: Three hand block-printed fabric notebooks in graduated sizes and different prints — floral, gingham check, and small floral — tied with cord.
settings.body: Move over the gift voucher and the box of chocolates. For the birthday, the farewell, the five-year mark, a block-printed notebook actually gets used — and with prints running from a quiet check to a full floral, there's a fit whatever kind of person you're gifting. It's the kind of small gesture people remember who sent, long after the occasion's over.
